detaileddescription.para: Tests cover: OM-01 loadFromJsonString round-trip equality (toJson → loadFromJson → toJson) OM-02 isA transitive closure (3-hop hierarchy) OM-03 allowedEdgeTypes returns correct set for known source/target pair OM-04 unknown concept → unconstrained (no throw, isA returns false, allowedEdgeTypes empty) OM-05 thread-safety: 16 concurrent isA calls on shared OntologyManager OM-06 build() seals the object; addConcept after build() is a no-op OM-07 isEdgeTypeAllowed returns true for unknown classes (graceful degradation) OM-08 loadFromYaml (inline string via temp file) produces same result as JSON OM-09 hasConcept / getConcept introspection OM-10 isA returns false for unrelated concepts in the same hierarchy OM-11 allowedEdgeTypes inherits through subclass axioms (indirect inheritance) OM-12 toYaml round-trip (toYaml → loadFromYaml → same concept/axiom counts)
